sequence.py: Nǐ bèi sā gǒu liáng le ma?
sequence.en: Have you been "fed dog food" lately?

sequence.cn: 撒狗粮，不是真的喂狗，是情侣当众秀恩爱。
sequence.py: Sā gǒu liáng, bú shì zhēn de wèi gǒu, shì qínglǚ dāngzhòng xiù ēn'ài.
sequence.en: 撒狗粮 isn't really feeding dogs — it's couples flaunting their love in public.

sequence.cn: 因为单身的人，常被叫做"单身狗"呀！
sequence.py: Yīnwèi dānshēn de rén, cháng bèi jiàozuò "dānshēn gǒu" ya!
sequence.en: Because single people are often jokingly called "single dogs"!

sequence.cn: 阿明，是我们火锅局上唯一的"单身狗"。
sequence.py: Ā Míng, shì wǒmen huǒguō jú shàng wéiyī de "dānshēn gǒu".
sequence.en: A-Ming is the only "single dog" at our hotpot night.

sequence.cn: 旁边那对情侣，你喂我一口，我喂你一口。
sequence.py: Pángbiān nà duì qínglǚ, nǐ wèi wǒ yì kǒu, wǒ wèi nǐ yì kǒu.
sequence.en: The couple beside him — you feed me a bite, I feed you a bite.

sequence.cn: 阿明夹起一片肉，只能默默喂给自己。
sequence.py: Ā Míng jiā qǐ yí piàn ròu, zhǐ néng mòmò wèi gěi zìjǐ.
sequence.en: A-Ming picks up a slice of meat, and can only quietly feed himself.

sequence.cn: 可是这次火锅局，阿明带了个女孩来。
sequence.py: Kěshì zhè cì huǒguō jú, Ā Míng dàile ge nǚhái lái.
sequence.en: But at this hotpot night, A-Ming brought a girl along.

sequence.cn: 只见他忙着夹菜、盛汤，疯狂撒狗粮。
sequence.py: Zhǐ jiàn tā mángzhe jiā cài, chéng tāng, fēngkuáng sā gǒu liáng.
sequence.en: There he was, busily picking food and ladling soup — madly scattering dog food.

sequence.cn: 原来，最嫌弃狗粮的人，撒起来最狠。
sequence.py: Yuánlái, zuì xiánqì gǒu liáng de rén, sā qǐlái zuì hěn.
sequence.en: Turns out, the one who complained most about dog food scatters it the hardest.
